journey.name: LC-02 Rotating the editor keeps a half-filled form
journey.description:
Covers NFR-06 for the editor. Every field is written through to SavedStateHandle on each change (TaskEditorViewModel.kt:76-92), so a rotation must return the form exactly as it was - including a priority chip the user changed and a due date they picked.
A restored form is also never reloaded over (hasSavedForm, TaskEditorViewModel.kt:55): what the user typed is newer than what the source holds. LC-04 is the harder version of the same rule.
Preconditions: adb shell settings put system accelerometer_rotation 0 adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Tap the element with the content description "Add task"
Type "Half a thought" into the "Title" field
Type "Started but not finished" into the "Notes (optional)" field
Using adb, rotate the device to landscape
Verify that the title "New task" is on screen
Verify that the "Title" field still contains "Half a thought"
Verify that the "Notes (optional)" field still contains "Started but not finished"
Verify that the "High" priority chip is still selected
Using adb, rotate the device back to portrait
Verify that the "Title" field still contains "Half a thought"
Verify that the "High" priority chip is still selected
